text.tspan: Booking, cash on pickup (DFD P31, P32)
Cash on pickup: nothing is charged at booking.
The OTP and QR are derived from the booking.
Planned: online UPI/card capture before Booked (coming soon)
Partner keeps the cash, the platform fee
is settled later by an admin (fee_settlements).

svg.text: Select partner, time slot, confirm booking
Validate slot, opening hours and price quote (P31)
Lock listing, re-check capacity, create booking as Booked (P32)
Record cash collected, final price (incl. overstay), 15% fee, mark Completed (P4)
